title: QuadPractice
description: QuadPractice is a Minecraft practice server focused on CPvP, where players can improve their skills, and compete with others in a fair environment.
body:
# QuadPractice

QuadPractice is a Minecraft Crystal PvP practice server where players can improve their skills, fight others, and train in a fair and competitive environment. Whether you’re just learning CPvP or already experienced, the server gives you a place to practice, challenge yourself, and get better at PvP.

We focus on smooth gameplay and fair fights so players can actually improve. QuadPractice is built for anyone who enjoys competitive Minecraft combat and wants a community to practice with.

# Server Info
IP: play.quadprac.co.uk
Edition: Minecraft Java Edition
Recommended Version: 1.21.11
Supported Versions: 1.21.x
Region: Europe
Language: English

The server is hosted in Germany to provide stable connections for European players.
